items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Each change is a small `if not ...is_cached(rel_obj):` guard. It uses the existing variable names and indentation, and the surrounding comments already explain why the reverse cache is set by hand.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Reuses the existing `is_cached` API with no new bookkeeping. The same guard appears in three descriptors, but each matches its own surrounding loop, so this is not harmful copy-paste. No dead code or debug output.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Only adds a conditional around existing cache assignments. Introduces no exception handling, magic constants or resource handling. Hidden tests passed: F2P 1/1, P2P 85/85.

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: Reverse-FK path is guarded with `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj):`. `ReverseOneToOneDescriptor` gets the same guard (`self.related.field.is_cached`). When the relation is not cached, the parent is still assigned, so plain prefetches need no extra queries.
